jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE photorealistic 3:2 interior design photograph, not a collage. Image 1 is the edit target of a compact Shanghai apartment living room looking toward dining. Preserve camera, dimensions, ceiling, every opening, dining furniture and pendant, olive green sofa, cream magnolia relief behind sofa, rug and scalloped coffee table exactly. Change ONLY the television wall at LEFT: replace the low TV console and plain wall above with one integrated shallow floor-to-ceiling cabinet wall, stopping cleanly at the existing glazed doorway without blocking it. Elegant warm ivory flush doors, honey walnut fine frames, two restrained woven cane inset doors, sparse tonal magnolia carving on one door. TV stays centered in an open recessed niche with cabinet storage above, below and beside it. Slim realistic shallow cabinet depth so walkway remains. Pale and spacious, not massive. Most fronts plain ivory, woven detail only about 20 percent. No new partition. Preserve sunlight and sophisticated authentic materials. No people, logo, text, watermark. No other redesign.

Use case: precise-object-edit. One photorealistic 3:2 interior design photograph. Image 1 is edit target. Preserve this exact compact U-shaped kitchen, camera, walls, back window, olive base cabinets, cream upper cabinets, sink, hob, hood, handles and daylight. Change ONLY the backsplash on the entire RIGHT hob wall: extend the beautiful abstract floral ceramic design from the small hob patch along ALL exposed backsplash from window corner to near right edge, continuous from counter to upper cabinets and behind hob. A single flowing restrained magnolia/petal composition across smooth glazed cream tiles, very low contrast mist sage and ivory, tiny dusty plum notes only, 75 percent quiet cream negative space. Delicate handmade glaze and subtle seams, cleanable refined luxurious residential finish, no extra decoration, no people, text, logo or watermark.

Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is architectural/camera reference for this compact Shanghai apartment. Right wall: low cream subtly curved sofa on slim dark feet, behind it a large quiet ivory wall with one sculptural interlaced pale wood relief, absolutely no flowers or botanical art. LEFT low long emerald lacquer TV cabinet with rounded corners and small woven tan leather inset, TV above. Pair of nested oval pale travertine and blond oak coffee tables; a small tan wide-strap woven leather lounge chair by the sofa. Back dining has compact blond oak oval table with cream banquette at back wall, two light woven tan dining chairs, graceful folded ivory ribbon pendant. Cream wool rug with subtle woven relief, original small cobalt ceramic vessel on table, one sculptural branch only at rear. Airy natural daylight, tactile leather and warm true colors, sophisticated editorial photograph, plausible small furniture and clear central circulation. Avoid dark olive, burgundy, petal lights, floral artworks, distressed antiques, ornate trims, enlargement, additional windows, text, labels, people or watermark.
